critical_code_review_comments: /app/scripts/spoof-tunnel.sh: the new plain-text UI helpers (banner/hr/pause/msg/yesno/input/choose) correctly send prompts to stderr and echo values on stdout so they compose with $(input ...) and $(choose ...) — this is what makes the menu driveable via piped stdin. Verified end-to-end.

main_menu() correctly consumes an empty line as a no-op (case '"" ) : ;;'), which is critical for the trailing newline that appears in printf paylobads like '7

0
' — the middle Enter never falls through to the 'invalid option' branch. Nice.

do_status() 'ping -c 3 -W 2' takes ~6s to time out inside the container (no route to 10.20.20.2). Non-blocking for tests but slows interactive UX; consider dropping to -c 1 -W 1 or gating on 'wg show' returning a peer. NOT a bug, quality suggestion only.

install.sh still installs 'whiptail' as an apt package (lines 55, 60). It is no longer used by the manager, so this is dead weight — consider removing to reduce dependencies and remove a potential failure surface. Non-blocking.

Container limitation (expected, NOT a bug): no CAP_NET_RAW → the C core's run/probe raw-socket modes cannot be exercised here. Only the menu logic (which is what changed) was testable end-to-end — and it fully passes.
seed_data_creation: Test script creates and removes /etc/spoof-tunnel/config; any pre-existing config is backed up to a tmpfile and restored at the end. Confirmed no residual state (dir removed).
context_for_next_testing_agent:
This is a CLI/network tool (Pure C core + bash installer + plain-text bash menu). Do NOT use curl/playwright. The menu is now text-based and can be driven via piped stdin, e.g. `printf '7

0
' | bash /app/scripts/spoof-tunnel.sh`. Reusable regression scripts: /app/tests/test_plain_menu.sh (new — menu UI), /app/tests/test_load_config_fix.sh (older, still runs but uses a whiptail stub — kept for load_config regression proof), /app/tests/test_install_deps*.sh (installer resilience). Container is aarch64 without CAP_NET_RAW; systemctl/wg/ping inside option 7 report inactive/down — that's expected. Always run as root.
rca of the issue: Not a bug this iteration — this is a UI overhaul verification. Migration from whiptail (which rendered slowly or not at all in Termius / small terminals) to a plain-text colored menu driven by 'read' is complete and correct: (1) no functional whiptail call remains in the manager (only 3 documentation comments), (2) the menu renders and re-renders correctly on any TTY OR piped stdin, (3) sub-menu (choose) writes the correct value to /etc/spoof-tunnel/config, (4) invalid input path emits the localized error and loops, (5) option 0 exits cleanly with rc 0, (6) the earlier silent-exit regression fix (load_config + 'set -o pipefail' only) is unaffected.
